Subject Matter: Terms of Office

Dates of Advertising in Times-Herald: June 10, 2007, June 17, 2007, June 24, 2007 Date First Presented by Council at Public Meeting:_June 11, 2007

Date of Second Reading and

Adoption: July 2, 2007
3:
WHEREAS, the Town of Sharpsburg (the “Town”) desires to enact an amendment to the Town Charter (the “Charter”) creating staggered terms of office for members of the Town Council; and

WHEREAS, the Georgia General Assembly enacted a Charter for the Town on March 24, 1978; and

WHEREAS, Code Section 36-35-3 of the Official Code of Georgia allows a municipal corporation to amend its Charter; and

WHEREAS, the Mayor and Town Council have complied with all the requirements of Code
4:
WHEREAS, Section 2-14 of the Charter allows the Town Council to enact ordinances to change and/or alter offices created by the Charter; and

WHEREAS, Section 2-11 of the Charter provides for the terms and qualifications of office for the Mayor and Town Council; and

WHEREAS, the Charter currently provides for all Town Council members to be elected to four (4) year terms; and

WHEREAS, the Town Council desires to create staggered terms for members of the Town Council; and

WHEREAS, the Mayor and Town Council desire to enact the following ordinance thereby amending Article II of the Town of Sharpsburg Charter;

WHEREFORE THE TOWN OF SHARPSBURG HEREBY ADOPTS AND ORDAINS THE FOLLOWING ORDINANCE:
5: The Town hereby enacts and ordains an amendment to Article II of the Town of Sharpsburg Charter by deleting Section 2-11 in its entirety and by enacting and ordaining the following language to be Section 2-11 of the Town’s Charter as follows:
6:
- (a) The Mayor of the Town shall serve a term of four (4) years and until his/her successor is duly elected and qualified.

- (b) The terms of office for the members of the Town Council shall be four years each; except for the election to be conducted on November 6, 2007, at which the terms for Post 2 and Post 4 shall be for two years, thereafter all subsequent terms for Post 2 and Post 4 shall be four years.

- (c) No person is eligible to serve as Mayor or Councilperson unless he shall have attained the age of twenty-one (21) years at the beginning of his/her term of office and unless he/she shall have been a resident of the town for a period of one (1) year immediately prior to the date of the election for his/her office and shall continue to reside therein during his period of service, and shall be registered and qualified to vote in municipal elections of the Town of Sharpsburg.
7: This Ordinance shall become immediately effective upon its adoption; however the newly established terms of office shall become effective on January 1, 2008.
8: The Preamble of this Ordinance shall be construed to be, and is hereby incorporated by reference as is fully set out herein.
9:
The sections, paragraphs, sentences, clauses, and phrases of this Ordinance are severable, and if any phrase, sentence, paragraph, or section of this Ordinance shall be declared illegal by the valid judgment or decree of any court of competent jurisdiction, such an illegality shall not affect any of the remaining phrases, clauses, sentences, paragraphs, and sections of this Ordinance.

Terms of Office Ordinance Adopted: July 2, 2007

ARTICLE FIVE This Ordinance shall be codified at said Article II of the Town of Sharpsburg Charter. ARTICLE SIX

All ordinances and parts of ordinances in conflict herewith are hereby expressly repealed.
